Coram : VIKRAMAJIT SEN*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
LAXMIDEVI v. STATE OF BIHAR & ORS. (Civil Appeal No. 3385 of 2012) JULY03, 2015 [VIKRAMAJIT SEN AND ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE,JJ.] Land Acquisition Act, 1894: s. 17 - Land expropriated by the State pursuant to the exercise of special powers in cases of urgency contained in s. 17 thereof for on the ground that resort to s. 17 was malafide - Writ petition disposed of with direction to pass award within 4 months - Award not passed till date - On appeal, Held: Appellants land owners were being denied just and fair compensation for their land in proceedings which commenced in 1987
Decision Date : 03-07-2015 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3385/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
